name: tabler-payments
description: Payment provider logo components for React, Vue, Preact and Astro.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run typecheck
scripts.build:packages: pnpm run build:react && pnpm run build:vue && pnpm run build:preact && pnpm run build:astro
scripts.release: git pull && GITHUB_TOKEN=${GITHUB_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token)} release-it --verbose

before:init: gh auth status || (echo 'You are not logged in to GitHub. Run `gh auth login` first.' && exit 1)
hooks.after:bump: npm version ${version} --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' exec npm version ${version} --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version && pnpm run build && pnpm install
hooks.after:release: echo Tag v${version} pushed — the publish.yml workflow will publish it to npm.
